precipitation_source: CHIRPS monthly, taluk mean, mm converted to m
temperature_source: NASA POWER (MERRA-2) monthly T2M at the taluk centroid, Kelvin; substitutes for ERA5-Land
terrain_source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 elevation and slope, substituted for SRTM in Presto's static slot
meteorology_caveat: Temperature and precipitation are reanalysis products at ~0.5 deg and 0.05 deg respectively, so both are constant across the taluk within a month. They supply seasonality, not spatial signal.
input_granularity: One series per parcel: the monthly value is the MEAN over the parcel's pixels (p1_acquire_stac.py), not a per-pixel series pooled afterwards. Presto was pretrained per pixel.
usage: Frozen pretrained encoder, no fine-tuning; the 128-d embedding is fed to the same MLP head and folds as GSE (p4 section C).
domain_shift_note: Presto was pretrained on Sentinel-2 L1C top-of-atmosphere; we feed L2A surface reflectance. A small systematic shift, reported rather than corrected. Any GSE-vs-Presto gap should be read with this in mind.
